a: A pin's or component's `description` (and `alpha`, `type`) is never type-checked, and a non-string description crashes `emitCss`
`equalize` changes a muted anchor's chroma upward, which its doc says never happens
`generate` reports `feasible: true` for a palette that equalizing pushed outside the gates
A child's own by-axis pin is filled from a parent pin that the child's own ramp shadows
An inherited pin silently overrides a semantic the child redefines, while ramp and scale steps the child redefines drop the parent's pin
`axisDependencies` keeps the last producer of a duplicated name; `derive` keeps the first
`generate` returns more swatches than `count` when there are more anchors than `count`
b: A parent's pin overrides a child's own semantic or component of the same name
derive throws a TypeError on an axis loaded as null instead of reporting it
Pins and components are not shape-checked, though a semantic rule with the same fields is
`{seeds.x}` inside a pin or component list is never resolved; inside a semantic `value` it is
emitThemes writes user-keyed records as object literals, so an axis value or theme named `__proto__` is lost
The hue search can return hue 360, which `order: 'hue'` sorts last instead of first
